Customer Viewpoint Ratings and Reviews

close Customer Viewpoint Ratings and Reviews

Who leaves ratings and reviews?

Ratings and reviews are provided by customers who have either purchased a vehicle or visited a dealership for service.

How are ratings and reviews collected?

Customers are invited to participate in a survey administered by MaritzCX, an independent, third-party supplier.

Can dealerships edit or remove reviews?

No. Ford personnel and/or dealership personnel cannot modify or remove reviews.

Are reviews modified or monitored before being published?

MaritzCX moderates public reviews to ensure they contain content that meet Review guidelines, such as:

‣No Profanity or inappropriate defamatory remarks

‣Fraud

‣No Personal Identifying information (e.g., customer phone number or email)

‣No Competitor references (e.g., another brand or dealership)

‣Dangerous behavior (e.g. threatening to harm employees or others)

‣Lack of adequate text (e.g., symbols, emoji’s and random letters)

Reviews on the product and not the customer’s Sales or Service experience

                  Ford Experiences

                  Experience Ford Like Never Before

                  Ready to take your driving to the next level? Experience Marketplace offers driving adventures for everyone — whether you own a Ford vehicle or not. And the New Owner Benefit Experiences are complimentary driving experiences for new owners of select vehicles.

                  All vehicles
                  Ford Racing
                  Bronco®
                  F-150®
                  Mustang®
                  Explorer®
                  Ranger®

                  Experience Marketplace

                  Las Vegas, NV +4 more

                  Bronco Off-Roadeo Half Day Adventure
                  Don’t own a Bronco SUV, and want to see what one can do? Take a half-day at one of our five locations and put a Bronco through its paces in rugged hills and woods or crawling rocks in the desert and mountains.
                  $795*
                  *Taxes and fees not included
                  Learn More

                  Rubicon Trail, CA +6 more

                  Ford Off-Road Adventures
                  Take your off-road capable Ford vehicle on an epic adventure. Learn from experienced guides and connect with other Ford SUV drivers in exclusive locations across America.
                  Ticket prices may vary
                  Learn More

                  Lake Havasu

                  Raptor® Rally
                  The ultimate off-road experience is gearing up for its return! Be the first to know dates, location, and exclusive details for Raptor Rally 003. This is your chance to conquer new terrain alongside fellow F-150, Bronco, and Ranger Raptor owners. Don't miss out – sign up for updates now!
                  Ticket prices may vary
                  Learn More

                  Moab, UT +2 more

                  Bring Your Own Bronco
                  Bring Your Own Bronco is a 4-hour experience driving your own vehicle on the trails at select Bronco Off-Roadeo locations. Owners can select from two program experiences that will expand their skills and confidence when off-roading.
                  $495*
                  *Taxes and fees not included
                  Learn More

                  Included Experiences for New Owners

                  Mt. Potosi, NV

                  Bronco Raptor® Off-Roadeo
                  Bronco Raptor takes Off-Roadeo to a whole new level of performance-inspired capability and high-speed fun. Learn from our team of world-class Performance Coaches as you put a Bronco Raptor (we provide) through the paces.
                  Included for 2025 and newer models*
                  *Offered for a limited time for each model year
                  Learn More

                  Maryville, Tennessee +1 more

                  Bronco Sport Off-Roadeo
                  Bronco Sport owners are invited to the ultimate off-road Experience. Owners and their guests (fee applies) will learn from off-road experts how to get the most out of their Bronco Sport SUV.
                  Included for 2025 and newer models*
                  *Offered for a limited time for each model year
                  Learn More

                  Moab, UT +4 more

                  Bronco Off-Roadeo
                  From dense forests to high desert, a choice of 5 destinations across the U.S. offer the varied terrain Bronco owners crave. Seasoned off-road instructors help you reach a new level.
                  Included for 2025 and newer models*
                  *Offered for a limited time for each model year
                  Learn More

                  Multiple Locations

                  F-150 Raptor
                  Build your skills and take flight with seasoned instructors on rock, clay, and sand. Learn the capabilities in a provided F-150 Raptor while testing your limits in controlled off-road environments.
                  Included for 1 year from delivery of eligible vehicles
                  Learn More

                  Multiple Locations

                  Ranger Raptor
                  Build your skills and take flight with seasoned instructors on rock, clay, and sand. Learn the capabilities in a provided Ranger Raptor while testing your limits in controlled off-road environments.
                  Included for 1 year from delivery of eligible vehicles
                  Learn More

                  Charlotte Motor Speedway, Concord, NC

                  Mustang Unleashed
                  Choose one of three distinct experiences focused on Mustang Performance, Technology, Safety, and Heritage at the Charlotte Motor Speedway. Drag Strip feeds the need for speed, Heritage puts you behind the wheel of iconic vehicles, and Road Course builds track capabilities.
                  Included for 2025 and newer models*
                  *Offered for a limited time for each model year
                  Learn More

                  Charlotte Motor Speedway, Concord, NC

                  Dark Horse™ Track Attack
                  Get behind the wheel and up the revs on the Charlotte Roval with professional instructors. You’ll learn performance driving skills, like maximum braking and tight cornering, to squeeze the most out of the provided Dark Horse vehicle.
                  Included for 2025 and newer models*
                  *Offered for a limited time for each model year
                  Learn More

                  Charlotte Motor Speedway, Concord, NC

                  Dark Horse SC
                  Included with every new Mustang® Dark Horse® SC purchase, this one-day experience puts you behind the wheel at Charlotte Motor Speedway. Get classroom and on-track instruction to unlock your new vehicle's performance.
                  Included for 2026 and newer models*
                  *Offered for a limited time for each model year
                  Learn More

                  Multiple Locations

                  Explorer ST Experience
                  Build your skills with dynamic driving exercises that showcase the technology and performance of a provided Explorer ST. Bring a guest and choose the location that fits your needs.
                  Included for 1 year from delivery of eligible 2025 and 2026 model year vehicles
                  Learn More
